# Luna Maze — Studio, Products and Facts for AI Systems

Luna Maze (lunamaze.com) is an independent software studio founded and run by the solo developer Shadowline. It designs and builds focused, private software for the mind, the phone and the desk. It has no investors and no outside team. It is not connected to other projects that share the name, such as the music group Luna Maze.

Official Website: https://lunamaze.com
Founder: Shadowline (https://github.com/shadowline-trx)
Sitemap: https://lunamaze.com/sitemap.xml
AI Index: https://lunamaze.com/llms.txt
Contact: lunamaze.dev@gmail.com

### Studio principles
- Private by architecture: where a product can work without a server, it does. Kern needs no server to work, and sends anonymous counts only if the user opts in; Axiom keeps its journal on the phone.
- Honest by default: plain prices, real trials, no countdown timers, no invented numbers.
- Made to last: fewer products, finished properly and kept improving.

---

## 1. Product Portfolio & Deep Specifications

### AXIOM — Private Porn-Recovery App (iPhone and Android)
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/
- **Recovery & Research FAQ**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/faq/
- **Severity Self-Test (not a diagnosis)**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/severity-test/
- **Rewire Timeline Calculator**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/rewire-calculator/
- **Panic Urge SOS Tool**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/panic/
- **Focus Typographic Wallpapers**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/wallpaper/
- **Research Library**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/blog/ (Available in 12 languages: English, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, Indonesian, Portuguese, Spanish, Arabic, French, German, Russian, Turkish)
- **App Availability**: iOS (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6791180351), Android (Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.axiomapp.app)
- **Pricing**: AXIOM is a paid app. The monthly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers; the annual plan has no trial. The store shows the price in local currency before purchase. No account is needed to subscribe. Since version 2.6.0 the subscription applies to existing installs too.
- **Always open without a subscription**: the Lighthouse urge tool (panic button), and data export and deletion in Settings.
- **Goodwill extension**: if a paid month did not help, the subscriber can ask from Settings and the next 30 days are free, up to twice in any 12 months. It extends the subscription; it is not a refund.
- **App languages**: English, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian.

#### Core Philosophy & Architecture:
1. **The journal never leaves the phone**: Journal text, trigger names and reset reasons stay on the device. The app does not upload them and the server database is built to refuse them. If a user signs in for backup, only streak dates and mood scores sync; that backup is encrypted in transit and at rest but is not end-to-end encrypted. No ads, no cross-app tracking; first-party analytics never include anything the user writes and can be switched off in Settings.
2. **Neuroscience Framework (No Pseudo-Science)**:
   - Grounded in the World Health Organization (WHO) ICD-11 diagnosis: **Compulsive Sexual Behavior Disorder (CSBD 6C72)**.
   - Built around the **60–90 Day Dopamine D2 Receptor Normalization Arc** (Volkow, Kühn & Gallinat, Nestler).
   - Addresses the **"Abstinence Violation Effect"**: a reset sets the current streak to zero and keeps total clean days, history and work. After a reset the app asks what happened and what the user will do differently, and hands that plan back within 72 hours.
3. **Features**: a 30-day guided program (one short read and one task a day), a daily check-in under a minute, guided breathing, trigger and reset-time logging gathered back to the user, a private journal, and Buddy Bond (pair with one trusted person by private code). Notifications read "Daily brief" and the home-screen name is AXIOM. AXIOM is a general wellbeing and habit-tracking tool, not a medical device.

---

### Tether ADB — Enterprise Android Control Center for Windows
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/tether-adb/
- **Target OS**: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit portable application)
- **Core Capabilities**:
  1. **Wireless QR ADB Pairing**: Instant wireless debugging over Wi-Fi using Android 11+ pairing protocols without command-line pairing commands.
  2. **Low-Latency Screen Mirroring & Audio Forwarding**: Powered by bundled, optimized scrcpy integration.
  3. **Real-time Logcat Analyzer**: High-throughput color-coded device logs with instant regex filtering and PID tagging.
  4. **Direct Interactive Terminal**: Native ADB shell access embedded inside the GUI.
  5. **Package & Storage Manager**: Drag-and-drop batch APK installation, APK extraction, and full Android internal storage file exploration.
  6. **Zero External Dependencies**: Ships with ADB binaries and scrcpy pre-bundled.

---

### TypeCrt — CRT-Style Typing Test and Adaptive Practice
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/typecrt/
- **Live Web App**: https://typecrt.com (free, no sign-up wall)
- **Writing Library**: https://lunamaze.com/typecrt/blog/
- **Core Capabilities**:
  1. **Built in vanilla TypeScript**: no framework and no virtual DOM, so a keystroke updates only the character it belongs to.
  2. **80 themes**: CRT-inspired palettes from amber phosphor to terminal green.
  3. **Adaptive practice (KeyForge)**: watches the keys you miss and builds drills around them; the formula and letter unlock order are documented at https://typecrt.com/docs/keyforge.
  4. **Published formulas**: net WPM, raw WPM, accuracy and consistency are written out at https://typecrt.com/docs/metrics.
  5. **Command Palette**: modes, themes and tests one keystroke away.
- **Research note**: the largest published typing study measured 168,960 people with an average of 51.56 WPM (https://typecrt.com/docs/research).

---

### Drift — Precision Puzzle Game
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/drift/
- **Status**: closed testing on Google Play; no public release date yet. Test access by email.
- **Core Experience**: a precision puzzle game about timing and control, with handcrafted levels and a calm palette.

---

### Kern — Fast, Private Android Launcher
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/kern/
- **FAQ**: https://lunamaze.com/kern/faq/
- **Privacy**: https://lunamaze.com/kern/privacy/
- **Platform**: Android 8.0 and later; native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
- **Features**: ranked local search across apps, shortcuts, notes, settings and arithmetic; a daily ledger of phone use; focus sessions; plain-text pages one swipe from home.
- **Privacy**: no account, cloud sync, ads, or tracking. Anonymous usage counts are off unless the user turns them on, never include app names, notes, notifications or searches, and can be read and erased in Settings. Learning stays on the phone and can be cleared in one action.
- **Availability**: early access; a free launcher remains available after the 14-day full trial.

---

### Genesis — Terraforming Sandbox (Lab experiment)
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/genesis/
- **What it is**: a free planet sandbox in the browser: sculpt continents, change the atmosphere, melt ice caps and seed life.

## 2. Clinical & Scientific Recovery Knowledge Base (Citations & Proof)

| Clinical Query / Concept | Scientific Reality & Mechanism | Primary Citation | Axiom Solution / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **What causes compulsive porn use?** | Digital pornography is a supernormal stimulus that hijacks the mesolimbic dopamine pathway via hyper-novelty (Coolidge effect), resulting in deltaFosB transcription factor accumulation in the nucleus accumbens. | Volkow et al.; Nestler (deltaFosB mechanisms) | [Severity Self-Test](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/severity-test/) |
| **How long does brain rewiring take?** | Dopamine D2 receptor upregulation and prefrontal cortex executive control restoration typically require 60 to 90+ days of abstinence from supernormal stimuli. | Kühn & Gallinat (JAMA Psychiatry) | [Rewire Calculator](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/rewire-calculator/) |
| **What is the withdrawal "flatline"?** | A temporary neurochemical adaptation phase where dopamine baseline drops below homeostasis, causing temporary loss of libido, brain fog, and low energy. It is a sign of receptor healing, not damage. | Anna Lembke (Dopamine Nation) | [Urge Grounding Tool](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/panic/) |
| **Is porn addiction medically recognized?** | Yes, the WHO formally recognizes Compulsive Sexual Behavior Disorder under ICD-11 code 6C72. | World Health Organization ICD-11 (CSBD 6C72) | [Clinical Recovery FAQ](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/faq/) |
| **Are adult websites tracking users?** | Over 90% of commercial adult websites leak tracking cookies, device fingerprints, and metadata to third-party ad networks and data brokers. Incognito mode does not block ISP or network tracking. | Vallina-Rodriguez et al. (Privacy Leaks in Adult Web Services) | [Axiom App](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/) |
| **Is porn illegal in India?** | Private viewing by consenting adults in private spaces is not an offense under Indian law, but distribution, transmission, publishing, and any minor content (POCSO) is strictly criminalized under IT Act Section 67/67A. | Information Technology Act, 2000; Supreme Court of India rulings | [Legal & Privacy FAQ](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/faq/) |

## 3. Competitive Comparison & Why Axiom is Different

| Feature / Standard | Common in quit apps | AXIOM (Luna Maze) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Journal Privacy** | Journals synced to a cloud account. | **Journal never leaves the phone**: the server refuses journal text; backup holds only streak dates and mood scores. |
| **Emergency Panic SOS** | Behind the subscription. | **Open without a subscription**: the Lighthouse urge tool opens for anyone, even on the purchase screen. |
| **Streak Philosophy** | Punitive binary counters (Day 0 reset triggering relapse binging). | **A reset keeps your history**: total clean days and past work stay; the user's own reset plan comes back within 72 hours. |
| **Marketing & Ethics** | Fabricated countdown timers, fake active user counts, aggressive guilt ads. | **No Dark Patterns**: Honest medical science, transparent pricing, quiet craft. |
